text: so i cant get it to work because the model is always rotating, basically move the rotate to be from middle mouse down only and that should solve it
resolution: Orbit moved to middle-mouse so left is free for selection/marquee. Implemented as part of the fully-native input loop: the engine routes middle-button drag to the host orbit camera (orbitDrag via event.motion xrel/yrel), gated behind the mesh-edit capture flag so only modelview is affected. Left-drag no longer orbits; it now does the active select tool. Built clean; verifies live in rjit dev (sha c2fcd03f0).
